$comment: Reusable ComfyUI workflows (API format, {{var}} templated) for the Webcules marketing system. Same convention as site-forge: defaults below are applied first, then per-run vars. Graphs are shared with site-forge where proven; vertical variants target 9:16 social specs.

z-image-turbo.title: Z-Image Turbo — fast photoreal (square/wide)
z-image-turbo.use_for: Photoreal background plates, product-style shots, lifestyle imagery for feed posts. 8 steps, ~5–10s.

var_docs.prompt: required — palette, subject, lighting, camera, mood

z-image-vertical.title: Z-Image Turbo — 9:16 vertical (reels/stories/status)
z-image-vertical.use_for: Vertical backgrounds for Instagram reels, TikTok, stories and WhatsApp status (1088×1920).

var_docs.prompt: required — vertical composition: subject centered, headroom top, clean bottom third for text

flux-schnell.title: FLUX.1 schnell — 4-step rapid art direction
flux-schnell.use_for: Fastest exploration of campaign look & feel before spending on finals. 4 steps, ~5s.

flux-vertical.title: FLUX.1 schnell — 9:16 vertical drafts
flux-vertical.use_for: Quick vertical concepts for reels/TikTok/status at 1088×1920 before committing to Z-Image finals.

qwen-image.title: Qwen-Image 2512 — flagship (text renders IN the image)
qwen-image.use_for: Hero creatives, mockups, posters — anything that benefits from readable text baked into the artwork (device mockups with screens, signage, 3D type). ~30–60s.

defaults.negative: low resolution, low quality, deformed hands, extra fingers, oversaturated, blurry text, distorted letters, watermark

var_docs.prompt: required — include exact text in quotes for in-image typography

ltxv-video.title: LTX-Video 13B distilled — fast text→video
ltxv-video.use_for: Quick video drafts: abstract loops, gradients, particles, texture motion for feed video backgrounds. ~20–60s.

defaults.negative: low quality, worst quality, deformed, distorted, motion smear, jittery motion

ltxv-vertical.title: LTX-Video 13B distilled — 9:16 vertical
ltxv-vertical.use_for: Vertical ambient loops for reels/TikTok/status at 576×1024 — draft motion behind text overlays. ~30–90s.

defaults.negative: low quality, worst quality, deformed, distorted, motion smear, jittery motion

wan22-ti2v.title: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B — image→video (landscape)
wan22-ti2v.use_for: Animate a finished creative into a cinematic clip (Facebook video, landscape reels). Draft 832×480×65 → final 1280×704×121.

defaults.negative: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

wan22-ti2v-vertical.title: Wan 2.2 TI2V 5B — image→video 9:16 (REELS/TikTok)
wan22-ti2v-vertical.use_for: The reel pipeline: compose a 1080×1920 still (bg + copy), animate at 704×1280 — text bakes into the motion, no ffmpeg needed. Draft 480×832×65, final 704×1280×121.

defaults.negative: 色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

var_docs.prompt: required — subtle camera + element motion (keep text areas stable)
